preconditions.text: A normal user stakes the minimum allowed amount of 10 gwei and receives kHYPE tokens.; The user queues a withdrawal, creating a tiny L1 operation of 1 in 8 decimals.; The L1 bridge rejects the tiny amount.; Other users have pending withdrawal requests in the L1 queue.; Production L1 bridges realistically reject the tiny 1-in-8-decimals amount.

- `StakingManager's` L1 operations queue contains no recovery mechanism. When an L1 bridge fails, subsequent operations become irreversibly locked, permanently blocking user funds. 3. Affects ALL users with pending withdrawals
